title_zh: 📚 阅读体验全面升级：90 项新功能上线
title_en: 📚 A Better Reading Experience: 90 New Features
content_zh:
这次一口气补齐了阅读、笔记、书架、写作台与社区的一批能力：

🔍 阅读器支持书内全文搜索、多色划线、朗读听书、护眼主题与引用卡片。
📊 首页新增阅读热度榜、日历热力图与成就勋章。
✍️ 写作台升级为多草稿、分卷章节树、版本快照与回收站。
⌨️ 按 Ctrl/⌘+K 可打开命令面板，按 ? 查看全部快捷键。

所有数据仍只保存在你自己的浏览器里，可在「关于」页导出备份。
content_en:
A large batch of improvements is here for reading, notes, bookshelf, writing desk and community pages:

🔍 In-book search, multi-color highlights, read-aloud, eye-care themes and quote cards.
📊 A reading leaderboard, calendar heatmap and achievement badges on the homepage.
✍️ Writing desk now supports multiple drafts, volume trees, version snapshots and a recycle bin.
⌨️ Press Ctrl/⌘+K for the command palette and ? for all shortcuts.

All data still stays in your own browser; export a backup from the About page.

title_zh: ❄️ 冬季限定飘雪主题已开启
content_zh:
初雪落下了。全站加入轻柔的飘雪效果，首页还有雪景背景与角落里的小雪人、圣诞树。

如果你更习惯安静的页面，可以点左下角的 ❄️ 按钮随时关闭；开启「减少动态效果」的系统设置时，飘雪也会自动停用。
content_en:
The first snow has arrived. Gentle snowfall now drifts across the site, with a snowy backdrop and little snowman / tree decorations on the homepage.

Prefer a quieter page? Use the ❄️ button at the bottom left to turn it off any time; snowfall is also disabled automatically when your system asks for reduced motion.

content_zh:
最新公告每天只会在你第一次访问时弹出一次，不会反复打扰。

想回看时，首页顶栏的「查看公告」按钮会打开完整公告列表，中英双语随时切换。
content_en:
The newest announcement appears only once per day, on your first visit — no repeated interruptions.

To revisit them, use the "Announcements" button in the homepage header to open the full bilingual list.
